name: Women Helpline 181
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_group: Women seeking support, information or assistance
eligibility: Available to women seeking information, support or referral under the Women Helpline service.
benefits: Information, support, counselling/referral and linkage to relevant services.
documents: Usually basic caller information; additional documents may be required by the referred service
application_process: Call the official Women Helpline service or access it through the relevant state implementation mechanism.
source: Ministry of Women and Child Development / Government of India
